mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS does not decline for 3 months, or the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals weakening labor market strength and consumer spending pressure.
failure_condition: If the UNRATE does not cross the 4.3% threshold within 3 months, or the 20-day forward returns are positive despite the trigger (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and contraction in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when both series move in tandem.
failure_condition: If the GDPC1 and INDPRO move inversely, or the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened market expectations of prolonged easing.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS decline isn't sustained for 3 months, or the returns aren't significantly higher than baseline in late-cycle expansion (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in housing-related demand (HOUST) above 1500 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days as it signals robust construction activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: If the HOUST does not cross 1500, or the 5-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High demand (GDPC1) coupled with low supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when both series move in tandem.
failure_condition: If the GDPC1 and INDPRO move inversely, or the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it signals a strengthening labor market and economic recovery.
failure_condition: If the UNRATE does not fall below 3.5%, or the 60-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market expansion, a surge in job creation (PAYEMS) above 10,000 monthly triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it signals robust employment growth.
failure_condition: If the PAYEMS does not cross 10,000, or the 60-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
